Data Centers Face New Environmental Review Demands

Authorities in some regions are introducing new requirements for environmental reviews for large-scale data centers. This includes a demand for environmental assessments for such facilities. The push for data centers, particularly those supporting AI, is leading municipalities to grapple with their impact and regulatory needs. The specific requirements and their implementation are being addressed as the development of these centers progresses.
